verdict.rationale: AMD provides official Ryzen AI SDK docs covering ONNX Runtime with C++/Python APIs, the Vitis AI EP, AMD Quark quantization toolkit, and the Lemonade SDK for LLMs, all live and crawlable at ryzenai.docs.amd.com, giving AI-native developers concrete official SDKs to build against. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports validating SDK usability/completeness, and no OpenAPI/formal API reference confirmed (probe found 404s for openapi endpoints).
